The bus card machine has become an important part of daily life. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. Max always says that small steps matter more than big plans. In fact, the flight delay was attributable to heavy fog.
Little by little, things began to change. The library desk looked quieter than usual that evening. Anna plans to study math harder this term. Khan opened a small restaurant on King Street.
On Monday evenings, Anna reviews the notes from class. Anna keeps a small panda at home and feeds it every morning. At first, Anna found it difficult to keep the habit. Steam rose from the bonnet.

They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. Anna is saving money to buy a ticket to Toronto. People around Anna often share different ideas about the library desk. Traffic banks up before the flyover.
There are always more possibilities than we expect. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right.
